tasks.title: Preserve Notes folder notebooks during reviewed Workspace adoption
tasks.body:
Goal:
- Preserve Notes schema2 folder notebooks across reviewed browser-to-cloud Workspace adoption without dropping folder state or freezing an unsupported source.
Current behavior:
- Notes native/cloud validation supports schema2 folders and folder receipts. validateTransferNotes accepts schema1 only and omits folders/folderReceipts/folderTransfers; mergeTransfer revalidates the target with the legacy shape. CaptureAsync validates NotesJson then freezes browser authority before cloud preview.
Desired behavior:
- Existing target folder journals survive legacy imports unchanged. Source folder notebooks receive complete reviewed support with exact source provenance, or an explicit refusal before freeze while the source remains writable. No successful adoption can silently lose a folder, membership or original receipt.
Touch:
- Shared transfer/Notes validators and marker models, transfer API and immutable source chunks, browser capture/storage/transfer controller, typed transfer reviews, existing MCP transfer/source-record tools and focused tests.
Implementation constraints:
- Retain schema1 fixture compatibility and original artifact hashes. Preserve folder UUIDs, current membership, folder state, project links, bounded histories and separate command/transfer receipts. Bind owner, browser/cloud source, original Workspace/notebook revision and target identity. Detect duplicate IDs, conflicting project/folder identities, purged records, capacity and stale target state before acceptance; existing explicit archive-conflicts review never grants arbitrary rebinding. Source receipts remain immutable and discoverable through reviewed MCP parity. Preserve target notebooks even when no source Notes are imported.
- Add a local compatibility preflight before FreezeAsync. Unsupported source/target capability must leave browser authority untouched. Interruption recovery uses the original transfer/artifact/receipt; no second writable browser/cloud source, blind replay, automatic folder copy, task effects or provider mutation.
- Before UI acceptance, register concrete current Release browser validation for every changed transfer route with light/obsidian, phone/desktop, normal/enlarged text, focus, geometry, disabled controls and account cleanup. Hosted/device/installed-PWA paths remain separately qualified.
Out of scope:
- General transfer redesign, additional nesting, automatic project association, publication, live account migration and provider/game effects.
Validation:
- Extend existing neutral schema1 transfer fixtures with independently specified schema2 folders, original folder receipts, current/historical membership, active/archived/purged records, project remapping and collisions. Native/Worker parity, actual SDK/D1, IndexedDB prefreeze refusal, concurrent revision conflicts and original receipt recovery require focused controls. Preserve all old fixture hashes.

tasks.title: Add reviewed day-bound tag projection for relative saved lists
tasks.body:
Goal:
- Enable explicitly reviewed Habitica tag projection for relative saved lists with exact local evaluation-day context and no unreviewed midnight effects.
Current behavior:
- Relative definitions/read pagination retain explicit timezone and day context. Desired groups expose relative_dates_require_review and retain membership; planner/executor/manual reviews refuse new work. This safe fence preserves absolute groups and original unknown receipts.
Desired behavior:
- A separate preview captures one server UTC instant, stored timezone, local day, interpreted bounds, exact native member IDs and complete additions/removals. Acceptance and fresh dispatch require the same reviewed day, source revision, ledger, account/consent epoch and original command identity.
Touch:
- Native/shared relative query and tag membership policies, tag work/review storage and hashes, planner/executor/reconciliation, reviewed group-tag MCP tools, typed clients and Sync review/status interface.
Implementation constraints:
- Preserve every existing native tag, ledger identity, unrelated upstream tag and unreviewed membership. Retain the unavailable fence until the complete new contract is supported. No scheduler, wake, definition edit or local-day rollover grants permission to change membership. Stale-day/revision/consent refuses fresh effects; recovery of an original uncertain dispatch precedes new context validation and never creates a replacement request.
- Bind the interpreted evaluation context and complete member pages into immutable preview/acceptance identity. Empty selection requires explicit complete review and never follows from unavailable data. Old absolute command identities, group semantics and accepted original receipts remain compatible. New work uses existing permissions and reviewed preview/accept/receipt MCP parity; no browser-only agent workflow.
- Register concrete current Release browser coverage for changed Sync/review routes with light/obsidian, phone/desktop, normal/enlarged text, focus/disabled/geometry, day-rollover restart and private account cleanup before implementation acceptance.
Out of scope:
- Automatic daily membership refresh, background consent, task creation/scoring, unrelated tags, publication and real provider execution without a bounded owner profile.
Validation:
- Independent UTC/local-midnight, date-line, DST, week/year and missing-date cases cover complete AND-filtered membership. Actual SDK/D1/synthetic provider tests prove reviewed exact additions/removals, stale-day and consent refusal, old queued-work fencing, concurrent/expired previews and original lost-ack receipt recovery with at most one dispatch.
